findings.claim: A shown full text still authorizes reliance on an unseen 'original manuscript': the fulltext-kind exemption bypasses that reference. Conversely, A3 assumes every 'main report' is another document. The round-19 fix does not establish document identity.
findings.guidance_basis: A3 forbids reliance on unseen sources. Contextual judgements must rest on relevant available information, not merely a matching document kind. [Handbook 8.2.3](https://www.cochrane.org/authors/handbooks-and-manuals/handbook/current/chapter-08).
findings.failing_test: Shown fulltext/quote='This follow-up report omits randomisation details'; 1.2 PY rationale='The original manuscript confirms randomisation details showed concealment' -> NI; currently PY. A shown main report should also remain usable when explicitly identified as the cited source.

findings.claim: MEMORY rejects legitimate reliance on a shown source before A3 checks its provenance. The rounds 16–19 decline preserves a guidance defect: saying 'published report' does not make a grounded rationale memory-based. Neither variant corrects this.
findings.guidance_basis: NI is appropriate only when reporting and contextual grounds are insufficient. A scope-based decline does not justify discarding available context solely because of its wording. [Handbook 8.2.3](https://www.cochrane.org/authors/handbooks-and-manuals/handbook/current/chapter-08).
findings.failing_test: Shown fulltext contains quote='central web-based randomisation'; 1.2 PY rationale='The published report describes central web-based randomisation, supporting concealment' -> retain PY; currently NI through MEMORY.

findings.claim: Every period followed by whitespace is treated as a sentence boundary, including 'Fig. 1'. This can remove the document reference from the quoted sentence and falsely classify a shown source's report as unseen. The alias tests omit this advertised spelling.
findings.guidance_basis: A3 permits reliance on documents reported by the shown source and explicitly supports Fig. 1/Figure 1 aliases. Supporting context should remain available under [Handbook 8.2.3](https://www.cochrane.org/authors/handbooks-and-manuals/handbook/current/chapter-08).
findings.failing_test: Shown abstract='Fig. 1 shows complete follow-up for all participants.'; quote='complete follow-up for all participants'; 3.1 PY rationale='Fig. 1 shows complete follow-up for all participants' -> retain PY; currently NI because the extracted sentence starts after 'Fig.'.
